dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: That's the way young people should be. Sails unfurled, revved up, ready to go and all that, just like these boats...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you gazing at the sea?

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: At the sea? No, no... I'm an officer of the law, from the Akademiya. Everyone calls me Master Adel.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: Simply put, it is the job of the Navbed to inspect a port's comings and goings. I inspect them in turn.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: You can think of me as their superior.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Youngsters heading out to sea?

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: Indeed! I mean, look at them, all fired up like that.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: When I was a lad, I too had the sea as my home, and I sailed everywhere on a patrol boat, even up to the border with Natlan. I'd go out there again if I could!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be off now.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: Haha, guess my only true companions are the wind and waves, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you were clearly gazing out to sea...

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: *cough* I was simply keeping an eye on the ships out at sea. Gotta make sure the Navbed aren't slacking off and all.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: Don't you take me for some skiving old man, now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been to Natlan?

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: Natlan's youths are as energetic as our own... No, in fact, I'd call what they have something else.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: It's almost as if... their souls were forged for battle from birth.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: Don't mistake my meaning, they aren't barbarians! On the contrary, they love street graffiti, showing off and comparing fashionable trinkets...

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: It's a colorful, contradictory, charming place.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, I'm practically getting younger over here, and yet our head administrator's always using "you need more rest" as an excuse to leave me idle.

dialogues.speaker: Adel
dialogues.text: *cough*...
